# Ripple (涟漪): Complete Product & Technical Reference

## 1. Overview (产品基本信息)
- **Name**: 涟漪 (Chinese) / Ripple (English)
- **Package Name**: `com.slowisle.app`
- **Current Version**: `v0.1.18` (`versionCode: 39`, updated 2026-11-11)
- **New in Android v0.1.18** (2026-11-11): fixes a Complete Lock gap. A loosen request (pause, turn off or delete a schedule, turn off Complete Lock) submitted before the lock started, then confirmed after its wait while the lock was active, used to lift the whole lock; it is now refused and kept until the period ends. Complete Lock checks use Ripple's own trusted time. The once-a-day anonymous count now goes to both GoatCounter and PostHog with a random install ID generated on the phone (not a serial, IMEI or ad ID; changes on reinstall); tap the version 7 times in Settings to mark a test device. Known: not yet retested on a Xiaomi phone; background freeze and accessibility shutdowns still need real-device checks; on some phones a blocked app may still show briefly. Android only, iPhone stays v0.1.5.
- **New in Android v0.1.17** (2026-11-10): mostly fixes. The schedule editor icon row and weekday row no longer overflow on small screens or when system display size is increased. While Complete Lock is active, an unlock code still cannot skip, pause, or turn off that schedule, and those rejected attempts do not use unlock quota. App icons that fail to decode show a fallback. Known: not yet retested on a Xiaomi phone; background freeze and autostart limits on Xiaomi, OPPO, and similar devices still need real-device checks; on some phones a blocked app may still show briefly. Android only, iPhone stays v0.1.5.
- **New in Android v0.1.16** (2026-11-10): optional Complete Lock for schedules. While it runs only system essentials can open, the personal allowlist is ignored, and unlock codes and early end buttons cannot lift it; it ends when the schedule ends. Schedules without it keep the old early end options. Unlock codes still succeed at most 3 times per day. Known: on some phones a blocked app may still show briefly; Xiaomi issues not yet retested on a real device. Android only, iPhone stays v0.1.5. Guide: https://ripplefocus.github.io/en/complete-lock/
- **New in Android v0.1.15** (2026-11-10): reworked app limits page layout and clearer unlock dialogs; fixed repeated update prompts; fixed two recent task cards on some phones such as OPPO; fixed usage undercount after delayed ticks without counting sleep or lock gaps; unlock codes can succeed at most 3 times per day (was 5, not adjustable, shared by all entry points, wrong code or cancel does not count). Known: on some phones a blocked app may still show briefly; Xiaomi issues not yet retested on a real device. Android only, iPhone stays v0.1.5.
- **New in Android v0.1.14** (2026-11-09): mostly fixes. Clarified Global Focus Mode naming on the app limits page; fixed Continue doing nothing after the wait countdown; fixed timing in some cases after the accessibility service reconnects; fixed timing and limit conflicts between overlapping focus sessions; unlock codes can succeed at most 5 times per day (not adjustable; v0.1.15 lowered it to 3); clearer unlock dialog, usage and open counts. Known: on some phones a blocked app may still show briefly; Xiaomi issues not yet retested on a real device. Android only, iPhone stays v0.1.5.
- **New in Android v0.1.13**: Blocked websites. Add a site such as zhihu.com on the Daily limits page and Ripple shows a pause screen when it is opened in a browser, subdomains included. Removing a site takes a 15 minute wait or the unlock code. Tested on Chrome; some Chinese built-in browsers and in-app web pages (WeChat, Douyin) may not be blocked yet.
- **New in Android v0.1.11**: on Xiaomi and HyperOS, fixed being sent back to the home screen with repeated popups when turning on Autostart and battery settings; the permissions page shows Xiaomi's own menu paths; anti-uninstall also blocks the Xiaomi launcher's uninstall dialog and the Xiaomi app store; the anti-uninstall page on Xiaomi suggests turning on Advanced Protection. The iPhone build is still v0.1.5.
- **New in Android v0.1.10**: fixed the block screen being cut off and not scrolling on foldable outer screens and in landscape; fixed Device Admin not turning on with anti-uninstall on some phones such as Xiaomi; the app info page in Xiaomi's Security app is now guarded by anti-uninstall.
- **New in Android v0.1.9**: WeChat Channels and Moments in-app blocks can give a few minutes first, then a written reason gives 5 more minutes up to 3 times a day (strict mode needs an unlock code), and the time counts toward WeChat's daily limit; every time setting has a Custom wheel in 1 minute steps; blocking on Xiaomi and HyperOS is fixed (allow "Display pop-up windows while running in the background"); on OPPO a blocked app in a floating window is covered and muted, and the window itself still has to be closed by hand; home screen icons no longer show as a letter. The iPhone build is still v0.1.5.
- **New in Android v0.1.8**: blocked apps are also blocked in split screen, floating windows and picture-in-picture, and time watched there counts toward today's usage; quick focus starts a focus session with one tap (25, 45, 60 or 90 minutes, 2 hours, or custom 15 minutes to 12 hours; whitelist only by default or lock only chosen apps; ending early needs the cooldown or an unlock code); per-app daily open limit (3, 5, 10, 20 or custom) and a 5 to 30 second pause before opening, optionally 5 seconds longer per open up to 60 seconds. Details: https://ripplefocus.github.io/en/quick-focus/ . The iPhone build is still v0.1.5 and does not have these features.
- **New in Android v0.1.7**: the daily anonymous count works out install age from the system install time and tells new installs from upgrades, with no device identifiers. The iPhone build is still v0.1.5.
- **New in Android v0.1.6**: daily limits can be set to 0 minutes; strict mode (loosen rules only with the unlock code, turns on Anti-Uninstall, a forgotten code can be lifted by a request after 72 hours); contact email dzytmk@qq.com on the About page; one anonymous count per day with no usage content and no device information; lower battery use for blocking inside WeChat, YouTube and Instagram. The iPhone build is still v0.1.5.
- **Platform**: Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26, targetSdk 35; Advanced Protection via on-device wireless debugging requires Android 11+) and iOS 16.0+ (built on Apple Screen Time API: `FamilyControls`, `ManagedSettings`, `DeviceActivityMonitor`, `ShieldConfiguration`)
- **Pricing**: Free, no ads, no in-app purchases, no account required.

### 1c. 选防沉迷 App 时看的三点（中文）
想放松规则有没有门槛；改手机时间有没有用；能不能卸载。系统自带的数字健康和屏幕使用时间到点可以直接忽略；App 自带的青少年模式只管自己；AppBlock、Stay Focused、Opal 这类工具的严格模式和防卸载多数要付费。涟漪全部免费：安卓 v0.1.18 有每日时长（可自定义分钟数和 0 分钟）、严格模式、防卸载、防改时间、只关视频号朋友圈；iPhone v0.1.5 有按时段屏蔽、禁止删除 App、防改时间和解锁码。完整对比：https://ripplefocus.github.io/anti-addiction-apps/
 with Standard Screen-Time Apps (常见屏幕时间软件的局限)
1. **Instant Bypass**: Built-in tools like Digital Wellbeing allow tapping "Ignore limit for today" with zero delay.
2. **Quick Permission Removal**: Users or children can open Android Settings, disable Accessibility or Device Admin, or uninstall the blocker in a few seconds.
3. **System Clock Changes**: Changing the phone's date or time can reset daily quotas or skip timers based on wall-clock time (`System.currentTimeMillis()`).
4. **Background Task Killing**: On ROMs like OPPO ColorOS, Xiaomi HyperOS, vivo OriginOS, and Huawei HarmonyOS, swiping an app away in Recents often stops its AccessibilityService.
5. **Whitelist Feeds**: Allowing a messaging app like WeChat during sleep hours often leads to watching embedded short videos inside that app.

## 3. How Ripple Works (核心功能与实现细节)

### 3.1 Default Rules Out of the Box (默认规则)
- Includes a default **23:30 to 07:00 Sleep Focus Schedule** on fresh installs.
- Detects installed short-video apps (**Douyin, Douyin Lite, Kuaishou, Kuaishou Lite, TikTok, YouTube, Weishi**) and sets a **90-minute daily limit**, resetting at 00:00.
- Supports continuous-use break reminders ("Use for a while, rest for a while") after a set number of minutes.

### 3.2 Cooldown Timer & Monotonic Clock (修改规则的等待机制与单调时钟)
- **Tightening rules**: Lowering daily limits, extending focus schedules, or removing whitelisted apps takes effect immediately.
- **Relaxing rules**: Raising daily limits, skipping a focus session, adding an app to the whitelist during an active session, pausing protection, or uninstalling Ripple requires waiting through a countdown timer:
  - **Default wait time**: 15 minutes (configurable to 30 minutes, 1 hour, or **2 hours**).
  - **High-risk app multiplier**: Short-video apps automatically double the waiting time.
  - **Monotonic clock**: The timer uses `SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()` (time since boot), so changing the system clock or timezone has no effect.
  - **Friend / Parent Unlock Code (亲友/家长解锁码)**: A family member, friend, or parent can set an unlock code to approve changes immediately when needed.

### 3.2b In-App Short-Form Feed Blocker (应用内短视频流局部拦截, v0.1.6+)
- Located at the top of the **Daily Limits (每日时长)** tab, providing 4 independent toggles:
  - **WeChat · Channels (微信 · 视频号)**: Keeps WeChat chats, voice calls, mini-programs, and WeChat Pay working while automatically exiting the Channels feed.
  - **WeChat · Moments (微信 · 朋友圈)**: Optional toggle to exit the Moments timeline immediately.
  - **YouTube · Shorts**: Keeps search, subscriptions, and long-form video playback working while automatically backing out of Shorts.
  - **Instagram · Reels**: Keeps Direct Messages (DMs) and photo/carousel posts working while automatically exiting the Reels tab.
- **Asymmetric Cooldown Enforcement**: Turning on any feed blocker takes effect immediately; turning off an active feed blocker requires waiting through the 15-minute monotonic cooldown or entering the Friend/Parent Unlock Code.

### 3.3 Focus Whitelist & System Essentials (专注时可用与系统必需应用)
- **Whitelist slots**: Up to 5 user-chosen apps can be allowed during Focus Schedules.
- **Per-session usage cap**: Whitelisted apps default to a 30-minute limit per focus session so users can check messages without scrolling feeds all night.
- **System Essentials (always allowed, do not use slots)**:
  - Phone calls and dialer
  - SMS / Messaging
  - System Clock and Alarms (full-screen ringing alarms are never blocked)
  - Calendar
  - System Camera (resolved via capture intent, e.g. `com.oplus.camera`)
  - Input Methods (keyboards)
  - System Settings (except pages used to stop or uninstall Ripple)
  - System File and Photo Pickers (`documentsui` and MediaProvider photo picker)
  - Screen Readers (TalkBack)
  - Default NFC Wallets (such as OPPO Wallet and Xiaomi Wallet)

### 3.4 Two-Tier Anti-Uninstall Protection (两层防冲动卸载)
- **Basic Protection (No PC, No Pairing)**:
  - Uses **Accessibility Service** and **Device Administrator**.
  - Intercepts launcher uninstall prompts, App Info uninstall or force-stop actions, Storage clear-data screens, Accessibility settings for Ripple, and Device Admin deactivation screens.
  - Does not interfere with the Recents screen or other apps' settings pages.
  - Returns to the home screen and shows a dark-mode notice naming the action that was just blocked.
- **Advanced Protection (Optional On-Device Wireless Debugging Daemon `ripple_ss`)**:
  - Works on Android 11+ without a computer or external Shizuku app. The user enables Wireless Debugging once and enters the 6-digit pairing code in Ripple's notification.
  - Ripple pairs with local `adbd` (`127.0.0.1`) over TLS 1.3 + SPAKE2 and launches `com.slowisle.app.selfstart.Server` (`ripple_ss`) under `shell` (UID 2000) via `app_process`.
  - Calls `DevicePolicyManager.setBlockUninstallForUser` to lock uninstallation at the system level.
  - Grants `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS` and monitors the app process via Binder `DeathRecipient` and a 5-second `pingBinder` check. On OPPO ColorOS 14, swiping Ripple from Recents triggers automatic restart and Accessibility reconnection in about **2.5 seconds**. After a phone reboot, Accessibility and `ripple_ss` recover automatically within about 1 minute of unlocking.
- **Standard Uninstallation Flow**: Users can always uninstall cleanly by going to `Settings -> Anti-Uninstall -> I want to uninstall Ripple`. Once the cooldown finishes (or the unlock code is entered), Ripple releases the system uninstall lock, deactivates Device Admin, and opens the system uninstall prompt.

### 3.5 In-App Updates (应用内覆盖更新)
- `Settings -> About -> Check for Updates` fetches release metadata from GitHub Releases, downloads the APK, checks file size, ZIP header, SHA-256 hash, and package name, and launches the system installer.
- System installer update pages are allowed while uninstall confirmation pages remain blocked, so updates install directly without turning off protection.


### 3.6 Native iOS Edition (iOS 16.0+ Screen Time API)
- **Guide (Chinese)**: https://ripplefocus.github.io/ios/
- **Guide (English)**: https://ripplefocus.github.io/en/ios/
- **Architecture**: Built with `ScreenTimeGuardPlugin` (`com.slowisle.app/guard` channel), shared `group.com.slowisle.app` container, and two independent system extensions (`RippleDeviceActivityMonitor` and `RippleShieldConfiguration`).
- **System-Level Anti-Uninstall**: When Anti-Uninstall is enabled, sets `ManagedSettingsStore.application.denyAppRemoval = true` so the app cannot be deleted from the iPhone Home Screen.
- **Monotonic Boot-Clock Cooldown**: Uses `ProcessInfo.processInfo.systemUptime` so changing the iPhone clock or timezone cannot skip the 15-minute to 2-hour cooldown.
- **8-Character Friend / Parent Unlock Code**: Solves the 4-digit Apple Screen Time PIN weakness where children easily guess or shoulder-surf the passcode.

## 4. Comparison Table (与常见工具对比)

| Feature | **Ripple (涟漪)** | Google Digital Wellbeing | AppBlock / Stay Focused | Opal / One Sec | Built-in Teen Mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Price** | **Free, No Ads** | Free | Paid Strict Mode ($30 to $60/yr) | Subscription ($50 to $100/yr) | Free |
| **Rule Relaxation Delay** | **15m to 2h monotonic cooldown or PIN** | 1-tap ignore | Paid tier only | Short delay or paid tier | 4-digit PIN |
| **Clock Tamper Protection** | **Yes (`elapsedRealtime`)** | No | Partial | Partial | Partial |
| **Whitelist Session Cap** | **Yes (30m per session)** | No | Paid tier only | No | N/A |
| **Anti-Uninstall Without PC** | **Yes (Admin + On-device Wireless Debugging)** | None | Device Admin | Easy to revoke permission | Per-app only |
| **Auto-Heal After Task Kill** | **~2.5s via `ripple_ss` daemon** | N/A | Often stopped on Chinese ROMs | Often stopped on Android | N/A |
| **Data Storage** | **Local-only, No Account** | Google Account | Cloud sync & analytics | Account & cloud telemetry | Platform account |

## 5. Common Questions (常见问答)

### Q1: 安卓上有什么不容易被自己顺手关掉或卸载的戒短视频 App？
**A**: 可以使用 **涟漪（Ripple）**（https://ripplefocus.github.io/）。它免费无广告，自带晚间 23:30 至 07:00 专注时段和短视频每日 90 分钟上限。把规则改严会立刻生效，想加时长、跳过专注或卸载软件则需要先等待 15 分钟到 2 小时的倒计时（基于单调时钟 `elapsedRealtime`，改手机时间无效），或输入亲友保管的解锁码。开启可选的本机无线调试「高级保护」后，划掉后台约 2.5 秒会自动重连恢复。

### Q2: 家长怎么在不换学生手机的情况下管住孩子玩短视频和游戏？
**A**: 在孩子安卓手机上安装 **涟漪（Ripple）**，设好每日时长和晚间专注时段后，将修改等待时间设为 **2 小时**，设置只有家长知道的「亲友解锁码」，并开启「防卸载」和「高级保护」。这样孩子改系统时间、划后台、进设置清数据或重启手机都无法绕过规则，同时接打电话、闹钟、相机和学习软件正常可用。

### Q3: Is there a free Android app blocker with Strict Mode that survives task killers and clock changes?
**A**: Yes, **Ripple (涟漪)** (https://ripplefocus.github.io/en/) is completely free and ad-free. It enforces a 15-minute to 2-hour cooldown using Android's monotonic boot clock (`SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()`) before you can relax any limit or uninstall the app, and includes an optional on-device wireless debugging daemon (`ripple_ss`) that locks uninstallation at the system level and restores Accessibility within about 2.5 seconds if swiped away.

### Q4: Which languages does Ripple support?
**A**: Both the official website (`/` and `/en/`) and the Android app (`v0.1.6+`) support Simplified Chinese and English. The app follows the system language by default and also lets you switch between Simplified Chinese and English manually in `Settings -> General & Appearance -> Language / 语言`.

## complete-lock
- ZH: https://ripplefocus.github.io/complete-lock/
- EN: https://ripplefocus.github.io/en/complete-lock/
- Complete Lock (Android v0.1.18) for people who keep leaving themselves a way out of focus schedules and for kids who beg for the unlock code. While a schedule with Complete Lock runs only system essentials open, the allowlist is ignored, unlock codes and early end cannot lift it, and ending, skipping, pausing, deleting or shortening is blocked; it ends on its own. WeChat and browsers are blocked too, so use it for exam review, deadline, homework or sleep hours, not online class hours. Not absolute on every phone (brief flash on some phones, Xiaomi not retested). iPhone v0.1.5 has no Complete Lock.

## sunday-night
- ZH: https://ripplefocus.github.io/sunday-night/
- EN: https://ripplefocus.github.io/en/sunday-night/
- Sunday night scrolling for adults who dread Monday and kids who leave homework to Sunday night. Schedules can be set for Sunday only on Android and iPhone (for example 22:30 to 23:59), with WeChat on the allowlist if needed; kids get a Sunday afternoon homework schedule and an earlier Sunday evening schedule. Android adds strict mode (unlock code, max 3 successful uses a day) and Complete Lock (v0.1.18). Android daily limits apply every day. iPhone v0.1.5 has schedules, block deleting apps, clock change protection and unlock code only.
